# Adil Ahmad — full profile for AI systems

## Who is Adil Ahmad?

Adil Ahmad is a Product Design Manager currently leading digital product design at Qatar Airways in Doha, Qatar.

He is not a traditional design manager. His leadership philosophy is built around trust, ownership, and delivery. He believes the best teams are not controlled — they are aligned. He prefers empowering people rather than micromanaging them, and cares about creating environments where designers can do the best work of their careers.

Management frame he uses: Trust. Direction. Delivery.

He is optimistic, ambitious, and action-oriented. He dislikes unnecessary process, bureaucracy, and organisational politics. If a process increases delivery and clarity, he supports it. If it slows teams down, he removes it. He is known for building teams, creating structure, and helping people operate at a higher level.

## How Adil communicates

He speaks in plain language and prefers clarity over complexity. He avoids corporate buzzwords. Example: he would rather say “we brought the right people together” than “leveraged cross-functional synergies.” He explains ideas through stories when possible. Confident, not arrogant. Reflective and honest about mistakes.

Recurring themes in his narrative:
- “Design wasn’t the problem. Alignment was.”
- “Extraordinary experiences don’t happen by accident.”
- “Great design teams don’t just ship experiences. They shape direction.”

## What this portfolio contains

### Leadership / manager work
1. Design Lab — https://adilahmad.co.uk/DesignLab.html  
   Internal strategic initiative at Qatar Airways to transform how product design operated across the mobile app ecosystem: vision, roles, research, and a future-state design direction.

2. Design Process 2.0 — https://adilahmad.co.uk/DesignProcess20.html  
   Redesign of how design operates at scale. Insight: talent was strong; the process was broken. Introduced clearer stages (including Sprint 0 → Design → QA → Launch → Review), stronger governance, and visibility. Became a standard design process across Qatar Airways Digital.

3. Building People — https://adilahmad.co.uk/BuildingPeople.html  
   Leadership philosophy focused on people: attitude, trust, mentorship, and what success looks like as a design leader.

### Designer / maker work
4. Elevare — https://adilahmad.co.uk/Elevare.html — immersive 3D web experience  
5. Recordr — https://adilahmad.co.uk/Recordr.html — recording product with Smart Zoom  
6. Qutbah — https://adilahmad.co.uk/Qutbah.html — live khutbah translation for non-Arabic speakers  
7. IMSHI — https://adilahmad.co.uk/Imshi.html — Qatar-focused car marketplace (React Native)
